title: Relationship Queries: has, whereHas aur withCount
objectives: `whereHas` se relation ki condition par filter karna

sections.heading: Relation ke basis par filter
sections.body: Aksar sawaal aise hote hain: 'kin posts ke comments hain?', 'kin users ne order kiya?'. Iske liye `has` aur `whereHas`.
explain: `whereHas('rel', fn)` – relation par condition lagake filter.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Top posts page
sections.body: Har post ke saath comments ki ginti chahiye, aur sabse zyada comments wali posts upar. `withCount` ek extra query ya N+1 ke bina ginti laata hai.
explain: Alias (`as approved_comments_count`) se condition wala count alag naam se milta hai.

sections.heading: Sum, average aur exists
sections.body: Count ke alawa aur aggregates bhi relation se lete hain:

code.code:
$orders = Order::withSum('products', 'price')   // products_sum_price
    ->withCount('products')                  // products_count
    ->get();

$posts = Post::withExists('comments')->get(); // comments_exists (true/false)

$post->loadCount('comments');                // already loaded model par

sections.heading: whereBelongsTo aur latestOfMany
sections.body: Kisi parent ke related records aur 'sabse naya/purana related' ke liye chhote helpers:
explain: `latestOfMany()` / `oldestOfMany()` – hasOne se 'sabse naya/purana' wala ek record.

errors.error: Call to undefined relationship [comment] on model [App\Models\Post]
errors.cause: `has()`/`with()` mein relationship method ka naam galat hai (singular/plural).
errors.fix: Model mein method ka sahi naam dekho: `comments`.

errors.cause: Bade tables par `whereHas` sub-query chalata hai aur foreign key par index nahi hai.
errors.fix: Foreign key column par index lagao, aur zarurat ho to `withCount`/join dekho.

tasks: `whereHas` se 'laravel' wale comments ki posts nikalo

quiz.q: Relation ki condition par filter ke liye?
quiz.why: `whereHas('relation', fn)` relation par condition lagata hai.

interview.a: `has` sirf relation ki existence/ginti check karta hai. `whereHas` relation par custom condition bhi lagata hai.
Related records ki ginti ek hi query mein milti hai, N+1 aur extra loading ke bina.
`with` poore related models laata hai. `withCount` sirf ginti (`relation_count`) jodta hai.
`hasOne` relationship ko 'sabse naya related record' bana deta hai.
Parent model dekar `where('parent_id', ...)` saaf tarah se likhne ke liye.

summary: `whereBelongsTo` parent ke records, `latestOfMany` sabse naya related record.
Bade tables par foreign keys par index lagao.
